# Introduction

# Methods
## Load necessary libraries
```{r load_libraries}
library(rgdal)
library(sp)
library(rgeos)
library(mapproj)
library(leaflet)
library(googlesheets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(broom)
library(geosphere)
library(raster)
```
## Load anti-shipping activity messages
```{r load_data, results='hide',error=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
## load anti-shipping data
ASAM <- readOGR(dsn = "data/ASAM_shp", layer = "ASAM 18 JAN 17", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
## Process dates, and filter out anything before 2012
ASAM@data <- ASAM@data %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(DateOfOcc),
         Year = year(Date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-DateOfOcc)

ASAM <- ASAM %>%
  subset(Year > 2012)
## Remove duplicates
ASAM <- remove.duplicates(ASAM)
## read in EEZ
eez <- readOGR(dsn = "data/World_EEZ_v9_20161021_LR", layer = "eez_lr", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## set projection
proj4string(ASAM)<-proj4string(eez)

## figure out eez and ASAM overlap
eezASAMOverlap <- overlay<-raster::intersect(ASAM,eez)
## set world base map
world <- map("world", fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE)
```
## Set up buffers and controls
```{r buffer}
## Just look at Somalia
somaliPiracy <- eezASAMOverlap %>%
  #subset(Aggressor == "Pirates") %>%
  subset(GeoName == "Somali Exclusive Economic Zone")

eezSomalia <- eez %>%
  subset(GeoName == "Somali Exclusive Economic Zone")

impactZones <- gBuffer(somaliPiracy,width=0.25,byid=TRUE) %>%
  SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(data=somaliPiracy@data,match.ID=TRUE)
impactZones@data$Control <- "Impact"

controlZones <- impactZones %>%
  gBuffer(width=0.25,byid=TRUE) 

controlZones<- controlZones - impactZones
controlZones@data$Control <- "Control"
```


## Plot data

```{r plot}

leaflet(data = world) %>%
  # fitBounds(0, 60, 35, 72) %>%
  addPolygons(
    stroke = FALSE, fillOpacity = 1, smoothFactor = 1, color = "white"
  )  %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = eezSomalia,
    group = "eez",
    stroke=TRUE,
    weight=1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>EEZ: </b>", GeoName, "<br>")) %>%
  addMarkers(
    data = somaliPiracy,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Reference ID: </b>", Reference, "<br>",
       "<b>EEZ: </b>", GeoName, "<br>",
      "<b>Date: </b>", Date, "<br>",
      "<b>Aggressor: </b>", Aggressor, "<br>",
      "<b>Victim: </b>", Victim, "<br>",
      "<b>Description: </b>", gsub("NA","",paste0(Desc1,Desc2,Desc3,Desc4,Desc5,Desc6,sep=" ")), "<br>")) %>%
  addPolygons(data=impactZones,
              color="red",
              stroke=FALSE,
              fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Reference ID: </b>", Reference, "<br>",
       "<b>EEZ: </b>", GeoName, "<br>",
      "<b>Zone type: </b>", Control, "<br>",
      "<b>Date: </b>", Date, "<br>",
      "<b>Aggressor: </b>", Aggressor, "<br>",
      "<b>Victim: </b>", Victim, "<br>",
      "<b>Description: </b>", gsub("NA","",paste0(Desc1,Desc2,Desc3,Desc4,Desc5,Desc6,sep=" ")), "<br>")) %>%
  addPolygons(data=controlZones,
              color="green",
              stroke=FALSE,
              fillOpacity = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Reference ID: </b>", Reference, "<br>",
       "<b>EEZ: </b>", GeoName, "<br>",
      "<b>Zone type: </b>", Control, "<br>",
      "<b>Date: </b>", Date, "<br>",
      "<b>Aggressor: </b>", Aggressor, "<br>",
      "<b>Victim: </b>", Victim, "<br>",
      "<b>Description: </b>", gsub("NA","",paste0(Desc1,Desc2,Desc3,Desc4,Desc5,Desc6,sep=" ")), "<br>"))
```
